entities.name: PMID:27520078
observations: Joukar et al. 2017 modeled an L3–L4 facet capsular ligament during physiological lumbar flexion using nonlinear finite elements.

entities.name: Lumbar flexion FCL shear
observations: A finite-element simulation reported prominent, inhomogeneous in-plane and through-plane shear deformation across the facet capsular ligament during lumbar flexion, particularly in its middle body.
This finding concerns tissue shear deformation; it does not establish gross tangential sliding of the capsule over bone.
